title: AI Product Strategy — Manage a Portfolio of Uncertainty
key_insight: Stage investments around evidence milestones: problem proof, workflow proof, quality proof, safety proof, and scale proof. Preserve options until evidence supports commitment.
body:
## Manage a Portfolio of Uncertainty

Several AI bets have unknown quality, adoption, regulation, and cost. Committing the full budget to one forecast hides uncertainty.

Stage investments around evidence milestones: problem proof, workflow proof, quality proof, safety proof, and scale proof. Preserve options until evidence supports commitment.

Strategy includes a stop rule. Record what result would pause, narrow, or end the initiative so sunk cost does not become the decision maker.
common_mistakes: An impressive model demo proves product value.
Inference price is the only product cost.
A strategy should continue regardless of failed milestones.
mini_exercise: Draw “Manage a Portfolio of Uncertainty” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Technical capability creates value only when it fits a user job, operating model, economics, and responsible adoption path.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Manage a Portfolio of Uncertainty,” explain AI Product Strategy without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
